newsitem.title: USA: Instant Video Q1 full results.
newsitem.headline: Instant Video Q1 full results.

text.p: Instant Video Technologies Inc said revenue for the first quarter ended March 31, 1997 totaled $467,879, as compared with $19,130 during the first quarter of 1996.
Income for the first quarter totaled $29,036 as compared with a loss of $302,243 during the first quarter of last year.

Instant Video Technologies designs and develops Burstware products and applications. Burstware optimizes bandwidth and network resources to enable the faster-than-real-time delivery of multimedia content material over networks.
